kubectl rollout restart deploy/flagd -n astronomy-shop; kubectl rollout status deploy/flagd -n astronomy-shop
agent.summary:
The anomaly came from the `kafkaQueueProblems` feature flag, which was set to `on`. I've turned it off. I didn't check Kafka lag or any other telemetry afterwards, so I haven't confirmed the lag has cleared.

- **Cause:** all the pods had just restarted and were running. In the `flagd-config` ConfigMap, `kafkaQueueProblems` was the only flag enabled. Its description says it overloads the Kafka queue and adds a consumer-side delay, which causes a lag spike.
- **Change:** I set `kafkaQueueProblems` to `off` in `flagd-config`, then restarted the `flagd` deployment so it loads the new value. The rollout completed.
